reserveReview.rationale: The 100% share-and-cash envelope mirrors IAUon and SLVon; issuer API Physical Gold weight describes the underlying ETF, not a measured GLDON reserve mix. Final Terms permit Other Collateral and Additional Collateral, whose current usage is not established. Program trust disclosures require additional collateral beyond full backing at all times and describe a contractually obligated Ondo Foundation guarantee through Flux Finance, Inc. These are documented program commitments, not a measured GLDON overcollateralization ratio or a token-specific independent reconciliation.
